title: Pronunciation overrides (foundation §5.4, as amended by audit #17/#21 and ruling 17)
description: Two lists: the SDK's global packages/game-sdk/src/speech/overrides.en.json and a game's content/pronunciations.json (the game's wins; an item's own fixes win over both). Applied after toSpeakable rule 1 (straighten quotes) and before rules 2–13; what an entry produces is final. Word keys match whole words (a possessive 's may follow) and CASE-SENSITIVELY — an entry for "US" never touches "us" — unless the entry sets anyCase. A superset of Blanks' lexicon (games/blanks/content/pronounce.json parses unchanged). The code's copy is the zod `pronunciationsSchema` in @partybox/game-sdk/speech; this file mirrors it.

patterns.description: Regular expressions (JavaScript, u flag) over what the word lists left, game list first; the replacement is final.

say.description: The replacement; $1…$9 and $& are filled in.

cards.description: Blanks' name for items; read as items (items win on the same id).

say.description: What every voice reads instead, as a lowercase respelling ("keen-wah"): espeak spells a capitalised syllable ("YON") letter by letter. With ipa, what Zira reads.

ipa.description: Kokoro phonemes (espeak notation), said as given. The part sent is { ipa, text: say ?? the word } — text is required on the wire so Zira is never silent. Every symbol must be in Kokoro's vocabulary (unknownPhonemes() is empty): Kokoro drops unknown symbols without an error.

phonemes.description: Part 00's name for ipa, accepted and read as ipa. Give one or the other.

spell.description: Letter by letter (letters go as phonemes, digits as words).

anyCase.description: Match the key in any case (quinoa, Quinoa, QUINOA). Default: the exact case.

why.description: Why the entry exists; not read.

itemFixes.description: Content item id (card, prompt, question) → word → entry, for that item only; the word `_whole` replaces the item's whole text. toSpeakable reads them with { itemId }.
